description: Tooltip or hover card composed on <pop-over>: hover/focus with delay, interestfor where available, Escape and outside dismiss

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Plain-text tooltip content (a <template data-tooltip> child wins; the trigger's title is the last fallback)

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Placement; tooltips default to top, cards to bottom

attributes.name: delay
attributes.description: Hover show delay in ms on the JS path (default 200; cards 300)

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Omit for a text tooltip; card for an interactive hover card

events.name: tool-tip:show
events.description: Fired (bubbles) as the tooltip or card opens

events.name: tool-tip:hide
events.description: Fired (bubbles) as the tooltip or card closes

childAttributes.name: data-tooltip
childAttributes.description: Rich tooltip content (HTML) for the default variant

childAttributes.name: data-trigger
childAttributes.description: Card variant: the element that opens the card

childAttributes.name: data-content
childAttributes.description: Card variant: the card body. Moved into the card while upgraded and put back on disconnect

childAttributes.name: title
childAttributes.description: On the trigger: tooltip text fallback. Removed while upgraded (kept as aria-label when it was the trigger's only name) and restored on disconnect

properties.name: isVisible
properties.description: Read-only. True while the tooltip or card is open
